messages:
Maya: Quick heads-up — Triton Health is paused on the POC. CFO pushed back on our committed pricing yesterday and legal asked for KMS BYO and SOC2 scope confirmation. They want answers by EOD Fri.
Jared: ugh — which pricing line? is this committed reserved pricing vs hosted?
Maya: They're comparing our Dedicated commit to a competitor's list price. CFO wants a 20% reduction on the first 6 months or they'll pull the pilot.
Priya: Do we have their expected QPS / token volume? that affects cost model a lot.
Maya: Yes — trial forecast: 5M tokens/month peak, 500k avg. 1000 concurrent sessions.
Jared: ok that volume suggests Dedicated makes sense. We can show a blended rate with burst to hosted.
Sam: KMS BYO: our Private flow supports customer-managed keys but for Dedicated we need to confirm HSM integration timeline. current estimate: 3–4 weeks to validate key wrapping flow in their VPC.
Noah: Legal: for SOC2 we can provide our attestation (Type II) and a controls mapping. If they need SOC2 footprint within their environment (e.g., private deployment controls) we'll need a short statement of work. Also need to run through data classification questions — can they share the questionnaire?
Maya: I'll drop the questionnaire now. 
Maya: @Noah attaching file: https://redwood.internal/attachments/triton-sq-2026.pdf
Noah: received. I'll start drafting answers. If they require contract language for KMS, we need a security addendum — I can sketch terms this afternoon.
Rita: I can set up an exec 15-min sync with their CTO and our VP of Product tomorrow to unblock the pricing conversation. Exec-to-exec is usually helpful.
Priya: For pricing, we could propose a timeboxed pilot offer: 3-month pilot with a stepped discount: month1 25% off, month2 15%, month3 5% and then baseline committed pricing after. That reduces CFO risk.
Jared: Also offer tech mitigations: prefix caching and a KV cache plan to lower token usage — show expected cost delta in a 1-pager.
Maya: Good. I need a price anchor to present. Can someone pull a quick blended rate for 5M tokens/month on Dedicated+burst? 
Sam: Quick calc: Dedicated baseline compute + ops = $0.018/token equivalent; with batching and cache could be $0.012 effective. (very approximate).
Jared: I'll create a one-page cost comparison: Dedicated vs Hosted burst vs Competitor list. ETA 2hrs.
Noah: On contract side: if they insist on KMS BYO we can accept with the security addendum + proof-of-implementation milestone in SOW. That adds legal review time but not a blocker for the pilot offer.
Maya: Great. Can we commit to draft pricing + cost sheet + SOC2 mapping + proposed SOW addendum by 5pm my time?
Rita: I'll book the exec sync for tomorrow 10am PT and include our VP product and their CTO.
Jared: Cost worksheet uploaded: https://redwood.internal/docs/triton-costs-391820.xlsx (contains scenarios and assumptions)
Sam: Dev note: to shorten KMS validation time we can run an initial integration test using our staging key handshake with a read-only key escrow pattern — reduces validation to ~7 days if Triton signs off on test scope.
Maya: That buys time. I'll propose the timeboxed pilot + accelerated KMS run to them.
Noah: I'll draft answers to the questionnaire and the security addendum redline. Expect first pass in 3 hours.
Jared: I'll finish the 1-pager with cost and throughput notes in 90m.
Maya: Team — thanks. Plan: 1) present timeboxed pilot + stepped discount 2) offer accelerated KMS validation 3) provide SOC2 mapping + security addendum draft 4) exec sync tomorrow 10am PT. I'll update prospect after we have docs.
deploy-bot: Deployed 'triton-costs-391820.xlsx' to shared drive at 3918201320
Maya: filing note — if Triton accepts pilot, SE to own the runbook and CS to own outcomes.
Rita: noted. I'll prepare onboarding checklist and success metrics doc if pilot approved.
Maya: OK closing the loop here — I will post the customer reply in this thread. :thumbsup:
